svg.aria-label: k6 closed loop: 8 virtual users each keep one request in flight. If the server handles all 8 at once, 8 req/s at 1 s; if it handles one at a time, 1 req/s at about 8 s.
svg.title: k6 closed loop: 8 virtual users each keep one request in flight. If the server handles all 8 at once, 8 req/s at 1 s; if it handles one at a time, 1 req/s at about 8 s.
svg.text: How k6 tests an endpoint: 8 users in a closed loop
Each virtual user (VU) sends a request, waits for the answer, then sends the next one right away.
200 OK, so the VU fires again
always 8 requests in flight, for 30 s
Server works on all 8 at once
Server works on one at a time
each request waits for the 7 ahead: ≈8 s

text.tspan: (Little’s law). A slow server doesn’t drop requests here: users just wait longer.
